evidence.quote: If progress continues broadly as expected, the Committee judges that a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted.
With progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have continued to strengthen.
Inflation is elevated, largely reflecting transitory factors.
The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent
Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals.
